pr_title: Fix double counting of IP addresses
pr_body:
The range allocator in pkg/controller/nodeipam/ipam/range_allocator.go
may call Occupy() on the same range twice:

1. Just before subscribing to the NodeInformer
2. From a callback given to the NodeInformer soon after registration

issue_context.title: Double counting in the IPAM
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


**What happened**:
With a /22 pod network and a /24 assigned to each node, a third node cannot get a pod CIDR if kube-controller-manager has ever been restarted.

**What you expected to happen**:
Once a third or fourth node joins, it gets a /24.

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:
```
minikube start -n 3 --extra-config kubeadm.pod-network-cidr=10.244.0.0/22
sleep 10
minikube ssh -- sudo curl -sk https://127.0.0.1:10257/metrics --key /var/lib/minikube/certs/apiserver-kubelet-client.key --cert /var/lib/minikube/certs/apiserver-kubelet-client.crt | grep '^node_ipam'
minikube ssh -- sudo pkill -9 -ef kube-controller-manager
sleep 30
minikube ssh -- sudo curl -sk https://127.0.0.1:10257/metrics --key /var/lib/minikube/certs/apiserver-kubelet-client.key --cert /var/lib/minikube/certs/apiserver-kubelet-client.crt | grep '^node_ipam'
```

150% usage on the IPAM controller is not a good sign.

**Anything else we need to know?**:
During the creation of the rangeAllocator, Occupy() is called twice on the pod networks. The first time is before subscribing to the node informer. The second time is during the node informer callbacks because on subscribing it calls Add for all existing nodes.

I will submit a proposed fix shortly.

**Environment**:
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): 1.19.2
